response_texts: Ja'zel wants to be a Great Cat. He does not wish to be a tiny little louse anymore.
That is why we trample on laws and morals and all else. As long as we do good deeds, our conscience will die in weakness and no longer trouble us.
Trample and crush, the Great Cat lies beyond that. And you shall get claws that can pierce even the ground blocking our endless fall.
Come on, Lalanoah, I was wrong. Please, come out of your room.
I don't know anyone called uncle Brandt! Go away!
Lalanoah, you haven't eaten anything today yet... It's bad for you. Come on...
It's fine, I'm not hungry! Leave me alone!
We have sweet rolls for dessert today. Don't you want them?
Wait... sweet rolls...
Are you all right, Lalanoah? If you don't want yours, I'll eat it.
Well... I don't want it! If uncle Brandt wants to eat it, he should just do it!
You really take after Gerhard. He was just as stubborn... What should we do...
The sole purpose of Mundus is to devour, and only through suffering of causality and the agony of death can we grow.
Struggle is duty. Slaughter is an honor. Extinction is an ideal. Violence is the universal currency of evil, and words are nothing more than cages trapping our thoughts.
Whatever the Worlding of the Words may be, Ja'zel's world can only be spoken of by carving it into flesh and blood with claw and fang and pain.
Did you say tuning boxes? What's in those? I don't believe machines can dream.
There are five chicks in the box. Exactly five, yes? No more, no less.
Chicks can dream, too?
Of course they do, happy dreams and nightmares. They are not so different than us, no?
The way you talk about this... as if it's a trick. No, I'd rather not pry anymore.
I will use Kalka's potion now. Stand next to Kanra. Don't move.
And I'll throw it. Here we go!
That was amazing. I'm actually surprised.
It was ridiculous and really stupid... Let's do it again.
Honey... Who is that with you? What...?
What? Um, this is...
Darling, I can explain! This guy forced me to screw a soul gem inside me and when I refused, he threatened to throw boiling water on me!
What? What are you saying?
Unforgivable! I'll make scrap metal out of you!
No no no no, it's a misunderstanding! A misunderstanding!
What's your homeplace like, after such a long time? Do you feel anything about it? Nostalgia, perhaps?
Nothing. I have no memories of it, and not even dust remains. And... my homeplace is Atmora.
Oh. You seem to have become quite familiar with this body. Well, I'm not all that impressed. You won't be able to return in case of emergency, will you?
I don't care. There are many alternatives. You can just cut me off when you don't need me anymore.
But wouldn't the suffering of being separated from your lord be intolerable? Though you may know something about it already, considering you lost your homeplace first...
Hmm... So, what have you been doing since then?
I found an interesting tree in Skyrim and brought a branch with me. Isn't it nice?
So you were reading books to a tree branch of all things? What, are you nurturing it for something?
Yes, that's right. It's a good child... I'm sure it will become a good bard in the future.
That's insane. Kittens are much cuter.
This could be the peddler's blood. But he must be severely injured... Losing this much blood... It's hopeless.
Rumors said it was supposed to be a white rabbit. This creature matches only the color.
If you still continue on... then I shall pray for you. May your death bring you peace.
Fine work, the test results are good. No signs of parasites.
What about the blood curse?
Neither of you show any signs of mutation yet. And your memory still seems clear, so you should be fine.
Oh, that's very good.
Laza, is that you? I'm too busy taking care of the guest. Go count the sheep for me, will you?
The Ashkhan showed up... So the witch should be nearby.
Look for the signs of life around the graveyard.
Understood! I'll look for anything alive. I will do my best!
Found it. She's there! She's there! Right under the statue of Boethiah.
A hidden room, maybe... this coffin is suspicious.
Cursed be the Snow Elves. As ye have betrayed and deceived, so be ye also betrayed and deceived.
Cursed be the elves everywhere. May your long life be stained with stench and filth, and may even the earth refuse your corpses.
Cursed be my homeland. May our tears never dry until the blood of the elves runs out.
Awww, this one is in trouble, such trouble! What should Khajiit do? What should Mar-dro do?
Are there no guards anywhere? Aedra, Daedra, anyone! Please, help Mar-dro!
Grolly, Grolly! I found a cookbook!
Oh, this looks interesting. May I see?
Yep, it looks like a bread baking book. Is it useful?
Oh dear, this is a little... It might be too early for Lalanoah.
Umm... why? Is it useless?
I am so embarrassed... Oh, yes. Let's make sweet rolls instead, okay?
Sweet rolls? Yes, yes! Let's go make sweet rolls!
